reason: Independent nonduplicative source-class omission check requested by the cell-resolved owner; EPMC/GEO is owned elsewhere and no actual native candidate is authenticated.
changes: One ordinary supported public CELLxGENE collection metadata endpoint may be accessed; original zero-network expectation is amended prospectively, not rewritten.

before_source_criteria.fields: Collection/dataset identity, source title/description, disease/source-author labels, primary citation/accession, assay/tissue/condition and annotation declarations only; no gene quantities or count matrices.
before_source_criteria.authentication: Exact source disease labels are leads, not confirmed native EMC without primary/donor/assay linkage. Generic disease labels do not transfer EMC or constitute negative results.
before_source_criteria.all_conditions: All returned exact and generic relevant source records retained; unreviewed primary/accession conditions stay pending, no favorable selection.

use: A genuinely additional author-annotated native EMC compartment RNA deposit could resolve a source readiness gap and permit the source-specific use already prospectively assessed. Portal inventory alone is not a finding.
defeat: No source-qualified author-labelled EMC measurement/control/annotation link; unchanged verified source already evaluated; returned metadata does not expose suitable native conditions; or hard stop. No matrices or inferred malignant classification.
route_policy: At most one ordinary GET, no failed-route retry, denial bypass, login or credential use. Raw collection JSON ignored and hashed.
